no_adcom_quote.quote: Not applicable. An Advisory Committee meeting was not held because no unexpected significant safety or efficacy issues were identified, and no controversial or challenging issues arose that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for RUKOBIA (fostemsavir, NDA212950). The Integrated Review's Section 11 (Advisory Committee Summary) states the meeting was not held because no unexpected significant safety or efficacy issues were identified and no controversial or challenging issues arose that would benefit from committee discussion. Accordingly, there were no AdComm-driven changes to the approval.
